title: Adaptive experiments with observational data: Efficient experimental design and asymptotic time-uniform inference for long-term treatment effects
abstract: arXiv:2611.30595v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Estimating long-term treatment effects in experiments requires waiting for outcomes to become observable, which can delay both the evaluation of an intervention and subsequent decisions. Recent econometric work has developed identification methods that combine experimental data with observational data containing long-term outcomes. This paper proposes using observational data available before the experiment begins not only for identification but also for designing adaptive experiments, in which experimental data are collected sequentially. To estimate the long-term average treatment effect as precisely as possible, we express its semiparametric efficiency bound as a function of the covariate sampling and treatment assignment rules and minimize the bound over these rules to characterize an optimal fixed experimental design. translated_title: 利用观测数据的自适应实验：面向长期处理效应的高效实验设计与渐近时间一致性推断
translated_abstract: 在实验中估计长期处理效应需要等待结果变得可观测，这可能会延误对干预措施的评估以及后续决策。近期的计量经济学研究已开发出将实验数据与包含长期结果的观测数据相结合的识别方法。本文提出，不仅将实验开始前已可获得的观测数据用于识别，还将其用于设计自适应实验，即实验数据被顺序收集的实验。为了尽可能精确地估计长期平均处理效应，我们将半参数效率界表示为协变量抽样规则和处理分配规则的函数，并在这些规则上最小化该效率界，从而刻画出最优的固定实验设计。该实验设计依赖于观测预测的处理特定条件方差。
tldr: 本文提出利用实验开始前已有的观测数据来设计自适应实验，通过最小化半参数效率界来优化协变量抽样与处理分配规则，从而实现对长期处理效应的高效估计和渐近时间一致性推断。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes using observational data available before an experiment begins to design adaptive experiments, minimizing the semiparametric efficiency bound over covariate sampling and treatment assignment rules to enable efficient estimation and asymptotic time-uniform inference for long-term treatment effects.
